Class HashMultiset<E>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
be.imgn.gaia.core.collect.HashMultiset<E>
Type Parameters:
E - the element type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Multiset<E>, Serializable, Iterable<E>, Collection<E>
public final class HashMultiset<E> extends AbstractCollection<E> implements Serializable
A modifiable multiset backed by a HashMap, the multiset counterpart of HashSet. Its elements must have consistent equals and hashCode methods.
  • It iterates in no particular order, with all occurrences of an element in a row.
  • It rejects null elements, but querying it with null, as in count(null), is allowed.
  • Its views and entries are live, and its iterators support Iterator.remove().
  • Its iterators fail fast when an element is added or removed while they iterate, outside of their own remove(). A change of the count of an element already there does not disturb them.
  • It is serializable if all its elements are.
  • It is not thread-safe.
Since:
0.1.1
